subject: faithful sayings
question: Paul calls this verse "a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation": "Christ Jesus came into the world to save ______."
options: sinners; of whom I am chief
answer: sinners; of whom I am chief
verseText: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.

subject: timothy's family
question: Timothy's unfeigned faith "dwelt first" in which two relatives?
options: his grandmother Lois, and his mother Eunice
his mother Eunice and his father
his grandmother Lois and his sister Claudia
his mother Eunice and his brother Tychicus
answer: his grandmother Lois, and his mother Eunice
verseText: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.

subject: scripture
question: Finish the verse: "All scripture is given by ______ of God."
verseText: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:

subject: grace
question: "For the grace of God that bringeth ______ hath appeared to all men."
verseText: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men,

subject: contentment
question: "But godliness with ______ is great gain."
verseText: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

subject: spirit
question: "For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of ______."
verseText: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.

subject: salvation
question: According to Titus, God saved us "not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his ______."
verseText: Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Ghost;

subject: doxology
question: "Now unto the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only ______ God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen."
verseText: Now unto the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only wise God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.

subject: charge
question: Paul commits a charge to Timothy "according to the prophecies which went before on thee, that thou by them mightest ______."
options: make full proof of thy ministry
verseText: This charge I commit unto thee, son Timothy, according to the prophecies which went before on thee, that thou by them mightest war a good warfare;

subject: shipwreck
question: Which two men does Paul name as having "put away" faith and a good conscience, and "made shipwreck"?
verseText: Holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have made shipwreck: Of whom is Hymenaeus and Alexander; whom I have delivered unto Satan, that they may learn not to blaspheme.

subject: salvation
question: "Who will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the ______ of the truth."
verseText: Who will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth.

subject: mediator
question: "For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man ______."
verseText: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;

subject: money
question: "For the love of ______ is the root of all evil."
verseText: For the love of money is the root of all evil: which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.

subject: paul's testimony
question: "I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the ______:"
verseText: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:

subject: false teachers
question: Which two men does Paul say "concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already"?
verseText: And their word will eat as doth a canker: of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus; Who concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already; and overthrow the faith of some.

subject: old testament
question: Whom does Paul say "withstood Moses," as a pattern for those who "resist the truth"?
verseText: Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also resist the truth: men of corrupt minds, reprobate concerning the faith.

subject: companions
question: Paul says "Demas hath forsaken me, having loved this present world, and is departed unto ______."
verseText: For Demas hath forsaken me, having loved this present world, and is departed unto Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus unto Dalmatia.

subject: companions
question: In 2 Timothy 4:10, Paul names three men who have gone elsewhere: Demas, Crescens, and Titus. To where had Titus departed?
verseText: For Demas hath forsaken me, having loved this present world, and is departed unto Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus unto Dalmatia.

subject: personal requests
question: What did Paul leave at Troas with Carpus, asking Timothy to bring — "and the books, but especially the ______."
verseText: The cloke that I left at Troas with Carpus, when thou comest, bring with thee, and the books, but especially the parchments.

subject: personal notes
question: "Erastus abode at Corinth: but Trophimus have I left at ______ sick."
verseText: Erastus abode at Corinth: but Trophimus have I left at Miletum sick.

subject: bishop qualifications
question: Which list is the correct beginning of a bishop's qualifications? "A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, vigilant, sober, of good behaviour, ______, apt to teach."
verseText: A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, vigilant, sober, of good behaviour, given to hospitality, apt to teach;

subject: bishop qualifications
question: Why must a bishop not be "a novice"?
options: lest being lifted up with pride he fall into the condemnation of the devil
lest the church be reproached by outsiders
because he cannot yet rule his own house
because he is not yet apt to teach
answer: lest being lifted up with pride he fall into the condemnation of the devil
verseText: Not a novice, lest being lifted up with pride he fall into the condemnation of the devil.

subject: deacon qualifications
question: "Likewise must the deacons be grave, not doubletongued, not given to much wine, ______."
verseText: Likewise must the deacons be grave, not doubletongued, not given to much wine, not greedy of filthy lucre;

subject: mystery of godliness
question: "Without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen of angels, preached unto the Gentiles, ______, received up into glory." What comes just before "received up into glory"?
verseText: And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen of angels, preached unto the Gentiles, believed on in the world, received up into glory.

subject: modesty
question: "In like manner also, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefacedness and sobriety; not with broided hair, or ______, or pearls, or costly array."
verseText: In like manner also, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefacedness and sobriety; not with broided hair, or gold, or pearls, or costly array;

subject: example
question: "Let no man despise thy ______; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity."
verseText: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.

subject: godliness
question: "For bodily exercise profiteth little: but ______ is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come."
verseText: For bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.

subject: elders
question: "For the scripture saith, Thou shalt not ______ the ox that treadeth out the corn. And, The labourer is worthy of his reward."
verseText: For the scripture saith, Thou shalt not muzzle the ox that treadeth out the corn. And, The labourer is worthy of his reward.

subject: church order
question: "Against an elder receive not an accusation, but before ______ witnesses."
verseText: Against an elder receive not an accusation, but before two or three witnesses.

subject: personal advice
question: "Drink no longer water, but use a little wine for thy ______ sake and thine often infirmities."
verseText: Drink no longer water, but use a little wine for thy stomach's sake and thine often infirmities.

subject: family duty
question: "But if any provide not for his own, and specially for those of his own house, he hath denied the faith, and is ______ an infidel."
verseText: But if any provide not for his own, and specially for those of his own house, he hath denied the faith, and is worse than an infidel.

subject: widows
question: A widow was not to be "taken into the number" unless she was at least how old?
verseText: Let not a widow be taken into the number under threescore years old, having been the wife of one man,

subject: man of god
question: "But thou, O man of God, flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, ______, meekness."
verseText: But thou, O man of God, flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.

subject: discipleship
question: "And the things that thou hast heard of me among many witnesses, the same commit thou to ______ men, who shall be able to teach others also."
verseText: And the things that thou hast heard of me among many witnesses, the same commit thou to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also.

subject: doxology
question: "Who only hath ______, dwelling in the light which no man can approach unto."
verseText: Who only hath immortality, dwelling in the light which no man can approach unto; whom no man hath seen, nor can see: to whom be honour and power everlasting. Amen.

subject: doxology
question: God is called "the blessed and only Potentate, the ______ of kings, and ______ of lords."
verseText: Which in his times he shall shew, who is the blessed and only Potentate, the King of kings, and Lord of lords;

subject: contentment
question: "For we brought nothing into this world, and it is certain we can ______ nothing out."
verseText: For we brought nothing into this world, and it is certain we can carry nothing out.

subject: confidence
question: "For I know whom I have believed, and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have ______ unto him against that day."
verseText: For the which cause I also suffer these things: nevertheless I am not ashamed: for I know whom I have believed, and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day.

subject: study
question: "Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly ______ the word of truth."
verseText: Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.

subject: foundation
question: What two-part seal does Paul say stands on God's sure foundation in 2 Timothy 2:19?
options: "The Lord knoweth them that are his" and "Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity"
"Sealed by the Spirit" and "Be ye holy"
"Grace and truth came by Jesus Christ" and "Abide in me"
"The just shall live by faith" and "Fear God"
answer: "The Lord knoweth them that are his" and "Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity"
verseText: Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.

subject: vessels
question: In a great house there are vessels of gold, silver, wood, and earth. If a man purges himself from the dishonourable, what does he become?
options: a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master's use
a workman that needeth not to be ashamed
a faithful man able to teach others also
answer: a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master's use
verseText: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour. If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master's use, and prepared unto every good work.

subject: youthful lusts
question: "Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, ______, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart."
verseText: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

subject: soldier metaphors
question: "And if a man also strive for masteries, yet is he not crowned, except he strive ______."
verseText: And if a man also strive for masteries, yet is he not crowned, except he strive lawfully.

subject: soldier metaphors
question: "The ______ that laboureth must be first partaker of the fruits."
verseText: The husbandman that laboureth must be first partaker of the fruits.

subject: persecution
question: "Yea, and all that will live ______ in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution."
verseText: Yea, and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.

subject: scripture
question: Paul reminds Timothy that "from a child" he has known the holy scriptures, "which are able to make thee wise unto ______."
options: salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus
answer: salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus
verseText: And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

subject: scripture
question: The four things for which Scripture is "profitable" are:
options: doctrine, reproof, correction, instruction in righteousness
teaching, rebuke, correction, instruction in truth
doctrine, comfort, correction, instruction in righteousness
answer: doctrine, reproof, correction, instruction in righteousness
verseText: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:

subject: man of god
question: "That the man of God may be perfect, ______ furnished unto all good works."
verseText: That the man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works.

subject: preaching
question: "Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season; ______, rebuke, exhort with all longsuffering and doctrine."
verseText: Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort with all longsuffering and doctrine.

subject: sound doctrine
question: Why does Paul warn that the time will come when people "will not endure sound doctrine"?
options: after their own lusts they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears
they are deceived by false workers
they love the praise of men more than the praise of God
they have departed from the faith
answer: after their own lusts they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears
verseText: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears; And they shall turn away their ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables.

subject: crown
question: What is "laid up" for Paul — "which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day"?
verseText: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.

subject: crown
question: To whom besides Paul is the crown of righteousness given?
options: all them also that love his appearing
all them that keep his commandments
all that endure unto the end
answer: all them also that love his appearing
verseText: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.

subject: companions
question: "Only ______ is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee: for he is profitable to me for the ministry."
verseText: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee: for he is profitable to me for the ministry.

subject: opposition
question: Whom does Paul say "did me much evil," adding "the Lord reward him according to his works"?
options: Demas the lover of this world
verseText: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil: the Lord reward him according to his works:

subject: greetings
question: "Eubulus greeteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and ______, and all the brethren."
verseText: Do thy diligence to come before winter. Eubulus greeteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.

subject: elders
question: Why did Paul say he left Titus in Crete?
options: to set in order the things that are wanting, and ordain elders in every city
to preach the gospel to the Cretians
to gather an offering for the saints
to plant churches and baptize believers
answer: to set in order the things that are wanting, and ordain elders in every city
verseText: For this cause left I thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that are wanting, and ordain elders in every city, as I had appointed thee:

subject: cretian proverb
question: Paul quotes "a prophet of their own" who said, "The Cretians are alway ______, evil beasts, slow bellies."
verseText: One of themselves, even a prophet of their own, said, The Cretians are alway liars, evil beasts, slow bellies.

subject: elders
question: For what two purposes must a bishop "hold fast the faithful word," so that "by sound doctrine" he may?
options: to exhort and to convince the gainsayers
answer: to exhort and to convince the gainsayers
verseText: Holding fast the faithful word as he hath been taught, that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers.

subject: grace teaching
question: The grace of God teaches us to deny ungodliness and worldly lusts, and to live:
options: soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world
humbly, purely, and thankfully, before all men
faithfully, patiently, and lovingly, unto the end
quietly, peaceably, and honestly, in all godliness
answer: soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world
verseText: Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world;

subject: blessed hope
question: "Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our ______ Jesus Christ."
verseText: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;

subject: holy ghost
question: The Holy Ghost is "shed on us ______ through Jesus Christ our Saviour."
verseText: Which he shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Saviour;

subject: good works
question: "This is a faithful saying." What does Paul want Titus to "affirm constantly," so believers "might be careful to maintain good works"?
verseText: This is a faithful saying, and these things I will that thou affirm constantly, that they which have believed in God might be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men.

subject: avoid
question: "But avoid foolish questions, and genealogies, and contentions, and strivings about the ______; for they are unprofitable and vain."
verseText: But avoid foolish questions, and genealogies, and contentions, and strivings about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.

subject: hereticks
question: "A man that is an heretick after the ______ admonition reject."
verseText: A man that is an heretick after the first and second admonition reject;

subject: travel plans
question: "When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, be diligent to come unto me to ______: for I have determined there to winter."
verseText: When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, be diligent to come unto me to Nicopolis: for I have determined there to winter.

subject: travel plans
question: "Bring ______ the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be wanting unto them."
verseText: Bring Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be wanting unto them.

subject: pattern
question: "In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine shewing uncorruptness, ______, sincerity."
verseText: In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine shewing uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity,

subject: purity
question: "Unto the pure all things are pure: but unto them that are ______ and unbelieving is nothing pure."
verseText: Unto the pure all things are pure: but unto them that are defiled and unbelieving is nothing pure; but even their mind and conscience is defiled.

subject: elders
question: An elder must be "the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of ______ or unruly."
verseText: If any be blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.

subject: Paul's calling
question: Complete: "And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who hath enabled me, for that he counted me faithful, ______;"
verseText: And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who hath enabled me, for that he counted me faithful, putting me into the ministry;

subject: Paul's past
question: Complete: "Who was before ______: but I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief."
options: a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious
answer: a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious
verseText: Who was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious: but I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.

subject: faith and conscience
question: Complete: "Holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have ______:"
verseText: Holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have made shipwreck:

subject: delivered to Satan
question: Complete: "Of whom is ______; whom I have delivered unto Satan, that they may learn not to blaspheme."
verseText: Of whom is Hymenaeus and Alexander; whom I have delivered unto Satan, that they may learn not to blaspheme.

subject: the mediator
question: Complete: "For there is ______, the man Christ Jesus;"
options: one God, and one mediator between God and men
answer: one God, and one mediator between God and men
verseText: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;

subject: the office of bishop
question: Complete: "This is a true saying, ______, he desireth a good work."
options: If a man desire the office of a bishop
If a man be called to teach
If a man love not his brother
answer: If a man desire the office of a bishop
verseText: This is a true saying, If a man desire the office of a bishop, he desireth a good work.

subject: ruling elders
question: Complete: "Let the elders that rule well be ______, especially they who labour in the word and doctrine."
verseText: Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honour, especially they who labour in the word and doctrine.

subject: great gain
question: Complete: "But ______ is great gain."
verseText: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

subject: the rich
question: Complete: "______, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who giveth us richly all things to enjoy;"
options: Charge them that are rich in this world
answer: Charge them that are rich in this world
verseText: Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who giveth us richly all things to enjoy;

subject: laying up treasure
question: Complete: "Laying up in store for themselves ______, that they may lay hold on eternal life."
options: a house not made with hands
a good foundation against the time to come
answer: a good foundation against the time to come
verseText: Laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold on eternal life.

subject: Paul's longing
question: Complete: "Greatly desiring to see thee, ______, that I may be filled with joy;"
verseText: Greatly desiring to see thee, being mindful of thy tears, that I may be filled with joy;

subject: the gift of God
question: Complete: "Wherefore I put thee in remembrance that thou ______, which is in thee by the putting on of my hands."
options: stir up the gift of God
answer: stir up the gift of God
verseText: Wherefore I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee by the putting on of my hands.

subject: Paul's offices
question: Complete: "Whereunto I am appointed ______."
options: a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles
a prophet, and a seer, and a sage
a ruler, and a scribe, and a judge
a shepherd, and a bishop, and a deacon
answer: a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles
verseText: Whereunto I am appointed a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.

subject: mercy on Onesiphorus
question: Complete: "The Lord give mercy unto ______; for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain:"
verseText: The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus; for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain:

subject: faithfulness of God
question: Complete: "If we believe not, yet he abideth faithful: ______."
options: he abideth not with the proud
verseText: If we believe not, yet he abideth faithful: he cannot deny himself.

subject: the great house
question: Complete: "But in a great house there are not only ______, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour."
options: vessels of gold and of silver
answer: vessels of gold and of silver
verseText: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour.

subject: purged vessel
question: Complete: "If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be ______, sanctified, and meet for the master's use, and prepared unto every good work."
verseText: If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master's use, and prepared unto every good work.

subject: form of godliness
question: Complete: "______, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away."
verseText: Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away.

subject: Tychicus
question: Complete: "And ______."
options: Epaphroditus have I sent to Colosse
Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus
Timotheus have I sent to Philippi
Titus have I sent to Crete
answer: Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus
verseText: And Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus.

subject: greetings
question: Complete: "______, and the household of Onesiphorus."
verseText: Salute Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.

subject: qualities of a bishop
question: Complete: "But ______, a lover of good men, sober, just, holy, temperate;"
verseText: But a lover of hospitality, a lover of good men, sober, just, holy, temperate;

subject: empty profession
question: Complete: "They profess that they know God; but ______, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate."
verseText: They profess that they know God; but in works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.

subject: older women's charge
question: Complete: "That they may ______, to love their husbands, to love their children,"
options: teach the young women to be sober
teach the young men to fight
answer: teach the young women to be sober
verseText: That they may teach the young women to be sober, to love their husbands, to love their children,

subject: redeemed people
question: Complete: "Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself ______."
options: a holy nation, separated and pure
a royal priesthood, called and chosen
a chosen generation, holy and blameless
a peculiar people, zealous of good works
answer: a peculiar people, zealous of good works
verseText: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.

subject: brotherly conduct
question: Complete: "______, to be no brawlers, but gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men."
options: To speak evil of no man
answer: To speak evil of no man
verseText: To speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, but gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men.

subject: justification
question: Complete: "That being ______, we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life."
verseText: That being justified by his grace, we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

subject: good works
question: Complete: "And let ours also learn to ______ for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful."
verseText: And let ours also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.

subject: the deposit
question: 1 Timothy 6:20 tells Timothy to "keep that which is committed to thy trust"; 2 Timothy 1:14 repeats the charge with which phrase?
options: keep that which is committed to thy trust
answer: keep that which is committed to thy trust
verseText: O Timothy, keep that which is committed to thy trust, avoiding profane and vain babblings, and oppositions of science falsely so called:

subject: sound words
question: 2 Timothy 1:13 commands "Hold fast the form of sound words"; Titus 1:9 links holding the faithful word to what ability of a bishop?
options: Be thou an example of the believers
Fight the good fight of faith
Hold fast the form of sound words
answer: Hold fast the form of sound words
verseText: Hold fast the form of sound words, which thou hast heard of me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

subject: godliness
question: 1 Timothy 4:7 pairs refusing fables with "exercise thyself rather unto godliness"; 2 Timothy 3:14 urges Timothy to what in the things he has learned?
options: lay hands suddenly on no man
be thou an example in word
verseText: But refuse profane and old wives' fables, and exercise thyself rather unto godliness.

subject: guarding the trust
question: Synthesis: both 1 Timothy 6:20 ("keep that which is committed to thy trust") and 2 Timothy 1:14 ("that good thing...keep") use the same single verb for guarding the deposit. Which?
verseText: O Timothy, keep that which is committed to thy trust, avoiding profane and vain babblings, and oppositions of science falsely so called:

subject: the gift
question: Synthesis: 2 Timothy 1:6 says "stir up the gift of God"; 1 Timothy 4:14 warns "Neglect not the gift". What action does Paul urge Timothy to take toward his gift?
verseText: Wherefore I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee by the putting on of my hands.
